purpose: Screen tests for the parent area, the PIN, the timer, remarks and the stop lock setup.
details: OuderBasis (also used by test_gemengd and test_stopslot) lowers password hash iterations and creates a database with a parent password. Covers access (first password, mismatch, three wrong, inactivity lock, --ouder), reports/export/calendar, managing a child (school year, timer, PIN, wipe, export all), display settings, the timer, 'Zeg het ons', the answers log and the stop-lock setup.
module_docstring: Schermtests voor het ouderdeel, de pincode en de timer.
